_note: Owner: Role Building. colors = class colour; traits.r = rank thresholds, traits.d = text; counter = +bonus damage from a class to the one it beats.

Warrior.d: Warriors stack +50% damage on each enemy they hit. Cap: 100% / 200% / 350%.

Healer.d: Revive one knocked-out ally: unit at 50% / 100% HP, commander at 50% / 100%.

Mage.d: Relic powers last 3.0 s longer / double. (No relics in this prototype.)

Judge Mark.d: Judge Marks gain 20% / 25% / 40% armor and 5% / 18% / 35% chance to slow on hit.

Ember Keeper.d: Every 5th attack attaches a flame sprite: 3% max HP per second. At 5, that attack also hits for 3% max HP.

Gusting Shallow.d: Every 3rd attack knocks up and stuns for 1.5 s / 3.0 s.

Quiet Concern.d: Quiet Concerns gain +5% / +30% crit rate and +5% / +100% crit damage.

Leaf in the Wind.d: 20% chance on hit to root the enemy 1.5 s and step behind it. At 5, +30% attack speed.
